title: RO Part Line
description: One line on the RO for a single part used on the job, with its cost, its sale price, and whether it's a warranty/core part.
x-sap-analogue: Goods movement / material consumption line (MSEG) charging a part's cost to the internal order
x-api-note: Parts lines are a nested array inside Get Repair Order v3, fully documented alongside labor lines.
x-confidence-legend: Every property carries x-confidence: documented | inferred | unverified, copied from docs/model/model.json field-level confidence -- never uniform across an entity.
